examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Three tabs with sliding indicator and horizontally animated panels. The active tab is held in `v-model`; clicking a tab or using Arrow / Home / End keys updates it.

examples.name: Centered
examples.summary: `Tabs.List align="center"` centres the tabs over a centred catalog, as the Marketplace page does. The row still scrolls from its first tab when it overflows.

examples.name: Standalone
examples.summary: A `Tabs.Item` used on its own, outside a `Tabs.Root` — a highlight chip rather than a tab. With no context to inject, the item reads its own `selected` prop, and it carries the pill treatment itself: the translucent mask, the hairline border and the small shadow that the List’s sliding indicator supplies in the composed case. This is the only story that renders that branch.

examples.name: Scrollable
examples.summary: More tabs than fit the container: on narrow (mobile) widths the tab bar scrolls horizontally instead of overflowing or wrapping, the scrollbar is hidden, and the active indicator stays aligned while scrolling.
